'''Yan Diomande''' (born 14 November 2006) is an Ivorian professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Midfielder#|winger]] for {{Spanish football updater|Real Madrid}} club [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] and the [[Ivory Coast national football team|Ivory Coast national team]].

Diomande started his professional football career in the United States when he signed for [[DME Academy]] in 2022. He also played for AS Frenzi and helped the team winning [[United Premier Soccer League|UPSL]] Premier Division title in 2023. While playing at DME, Diomande had taken part of trials with a number of European clubs. He joined [[CD Leganés|Leganés]] in January 2025, before moving to [[RB Leipzig]] in July 2025 for a reported €20m. After one season in Germany, Diomande joined Real Madrid in August 2026 for a reported €125m plus €15m in potential add-ons, becoming the club's record signing and the [[List of most expensive association football transfers|most expensive African player in history]].

Diomande represented Ivory Coast at the [[Ivory Coast national under-17 football team|under-17]] and [[Ivory Coast national under-23 football team|under-23]] levels before progressing to the senior team. He made his senior debut in 2025 and was part of the squad for the [[2025 Africa Cup of Nations]] and the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]], helping his national team reach the knockout stage for the first time in the nation's history.

==Club career==
===Early career===
In 2023, Diomande played with AS Frenzi in the [[United Premier Soccer League]] Premier Division, helping them win the league title.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://dmeacademy.com/diomande-as-frenzi-title/|title=ICYMI: Diomande Leads AS Frenzi to 2023 UPSL Title|publisher=DME Academy|date=16 August 2023|accessdate=31 March 2025|archive-date=10 October 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251010085345/https://dmeacademy.com/diomande-as-frenzi-title/|url-status=live}}</ref> In October of that year, he went on a trial at Scottish side [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ibroxnews.com/2023/10/08/rangers-news-as-ivory-coast-sensation-yan-diomande-arrives-on-trial/|title=Rangers news as Ivory Coast sensation Yan Diomande arrives on trial|publisher=Ibrox News|date=8 October 2023|accessdate=31 March 2025}}</ref> but ended up not signing a contract and returned to the United States.

officially joining the club in January.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://premier.upsl.com/former-upsl-national-finals-mvp-yan-diomande-has-joined-la-liga-side-cd-leganes/|title=Former UPSL National Finals On 7 March 2026, Diomande scored his tenth Bundesliga goal in a 2–1 victory over Augsburg at the age of 19 years and 114 days, becoming the fourth-youngest player to achieve the feat in a single campaign, behind [[Olaf Thon]], [[Lukas Podolski]] and [[Jadon Sancho]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/yan-diomande-makes-history-augsburg-werner-36330 |title=Yan Diomande makes Bundesliga history against Augsburg |publisher=Bundesliga |date=7 March 2026 |access-date=26 July 2026 |archive-date=31 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260731021216/https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/yan-diomande-makes-history-augsburg-werner-36330 |url-status=live }}</ref> Diomande finished the [[2025–26 Bundesliga|2025–26 season]] with 12 goals and 9 assists, ending just one goal behind the club's top scorer, [[Christoph Baumgartner]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/rb-leipzig-stand-firm-yan-073000811.html |title=RB Leipzig stand firm on Yan Diomande’s valuation |publisher=Yahoo! Sports |date=19 June 2026 |access-date=26 July 2026 |archive-date=20 June 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260620072440/https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/rb-leipzig-stand-firm-yan-073000811.html |url-status=live }}</ref> He was named Bundesliga Player of the Month in [[2025–26 Bundesliga#Monthly awards|April 2026]],<ref name="BPOTM">{{cite news|title=Bundesliga Player of the Month|url=https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/player-of-the-month-2025-26-vote-winners-ea-sports-34233|access-date=18 May 2026|publisher=Bundesliga|archive-date=10 January 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260110223742/https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/player-of-the-month-2025-26-vote-winners-ea-sports-34233|url-status=live}}</ref> and Bundesliga Rookie of the Month in December 2025 and February 2026.<ref name="BROTM">{{cite web|title=Bundesliga Rookie Award|url=https://www.rookie-award.com/?lang=en|access-date=18 May 2026|publisher=Bundesliga|archive-date=23 October 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201023011407/https://rookie-award.com/|url-status=live}}</ref>

===Real Madrid===
On 6 August 2026, Diomande returned to La Liga, signing for Real Madrid on a seven-year contract until 30 June 2033.<ref>{{cite news |date=6 August 2026 |title=Official Announcement: Diomande |url=https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/news/club/announcements/comunicado-oficial-diomande-06-08-2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260806140626/https://www.realmadrid.com/en-US/news/club/announcements/comunicado-oficial-diomande-06-08-2026 |archive-date=6 August 2026 |access-date=6 August 2026 |publisher=Real Madrid CF}}</ref> The transfer fee was reported at €125 million, with up to €15 million in potential add-ons.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Cortegana|first1=Mario|last2=Stafford-Bloor|first2=Sebastian|title=Real Madrid complete €140m Yan Diomande transfer from RB Leipzig on seven-year deal|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7483871/2026/08/05/yan-diomande-real-madrid-transfer-news/|publisher=The New York Times|issn=0362-4331|work=The Athletic|date=6 August 2026|access-date=6 August 2026|archive-date=6 August 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260806162454/https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7483871/2026/08/05/yan-diomande-real-madrid-transfer-news/|url-status=live}}</ref> The move made him Real Madrid's record signing, surpassing the fee paid for midfielder [[Jude Bellingham]], and the first Ivorian player to sign for ''Los Blancos''. It also broke compatriot [[Nicolas Pépé]]'s record as the [[List of most expensive association football transfers|most expensive African player in history]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Conway |first=Elizabeth |last2=Coates |first2=Charlotte |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c4g3906pz65o |title=Real Madrid sign Diomande from RB Leipzig |publisher=BBC Sport |date=6 August 2026 |access-date=6 August 2026 |archive-date=7 August 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260807090026/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c4g3906pz65o |url-status=live }}</ref> He made his debut on 22 August, coming in as a substitute for [[Arda Güler]] in a 2–1 win at [[RCD Espanyol|Espanyol]].<ref>{{cite web|last=Rindl|first=Joe|title=Debutant Espí gives Mourinho winning Real Madrid return|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cmwyjzndv4xnt|publisher=BBC|work=BBC Sport|date=22 August 2026|access-date=22 August 2026|archive-date=23 August 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260823180042/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cmwyjzndv4xnt|url-status=live}}</ref> 

On 10 October, Diomande scored his first goal for the club, which secured a 1–0 win over [[Villarreal CF|Villarreal]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Real Madrid 1–0 Villarreal: Vinícius Jr sent off for hair pull in win|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cx30eppd991et|publisher=BBC Sport|date=10 October 2026|access-date=11 October 2026|archive-date=11 October 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20261011113723/https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cx30eppd991et|url-status=live}}</ref> A week later, he registered a goal and an assist in a 4–1 win against [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]], becoming the youngest player to score and assist in the same La Liga match for the club in the 21st century, breaking a record previously held by Jude Bellingham.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.goal.com/en/lists/yan-diomande-breaks-jude-bellingham-record-real-madrid-sevilla/blt904fcd89286c1c61 |title=Better than Jude! Yan Diomande shatters Bellingham record as Real Madrid starlet makes history in Sevilla thrashing |publisher=Goal.com |date=19 October 2026 |access-date=20 October 2026}}</ref> Four days later, on 21 October, he scored his first [[UEFA Champions League]] goal and provided an assist for [[Kylian Mbappé]] in a 4–1 victory over former club Leipzig after coming on as a substitute for [[Vinícius Júnior]] in the 69th minute. This made him the youngest Real Madrid substitute to score and assist in a UEFA Champions League match, breaking [[Guti]]'s record set in 1999.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/real-madrid-summer-signing-breaks-214000819.html |title=Real Madrid summer signing breaks Guti's record in win over RB Leipzig |publisher=Yahoo Sports |access-date=22 October 2026}}</ref>

On 15 May 2026, Diomande was selected by head coach [[Emerse Faé]] in Ivory Coast's 26-player squad for the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]].<ref>{{cite web |access-date=2 June 2026 |date=15 May 2026 |language=fr |title=La liste de la Côte d'Ivoire pour la Coupe du Monde 2026 |url=https://www.fifa.com/fr/articles/liste-cote-d-ivoire-coupe-du-monde-2026 |website=[[FIFA]] |archive-date=5 June 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260605081628/https://www.fifa.com/fr/articles/liste-cote-d-ivoire-coupe-du-monde-2026 |url-status=live }}</ref> He started in the opening match against [[Ecuador national football team|Ecuador]], which ended in a 1–0 victory, and was named man of the match for his performance.<ref>{{cite web |author=Isidore Akouete |title=Yan Diomande : " Nous sommes ici pour écrire notre propre histoire " |url=https://africafoot.com/yan-diomande-nous-sommes-ici-pour-ecrire-notre-propre-histoire/ |website=Africafoot |date=15 June 2026 |access-date=16 June 2026 |archive-date=16 June 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260616103000/https://africafoot.com/yan-diomande-nous-sommes-ici-pour-ecrire-notre-propre-histoire/ |url-status=live }}</ref> He also became the youngest player to appear for his country at a World Cup at 19 years and 212 days.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/cote-d-ivoire-ecuador-highlights-match-report |title=Amad strikes late to clinch dramatic Côte d'Ivoire win |publisher=FIFA |date=15 June 2026 |access-date=17 June 2026 |archive-date=20 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260720114737/https://www.fifa.com/en/tournaments/mens/worldcup/canadamexicousa2026/articles/cote-d-ivoire-ecuador-highlights-match-report |url-status=live }}</ref> On 25 June, he provided an assist in a 2–0 victory over [[Curaçao national football team|Curaçao]], becoming the youngest Ivorian player to achieve this feat at the age of 19 years and 223 days.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/yan-diomandes-superb-world-cup-212500128.html |title=Yan Diomande's stunning World Cup record |publisher=Yahoo! Sports |date=25 June 2026 |access-date=26 June 2026 |archive-date=26 June 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260626074230/https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/yan-diomandes-superb-world-cup-212500128.html |url-status=live }}</ref> The win also secured Ivory Coast's first-ever qualification for the knockout stage of the FIFA World Cup.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/sports/20260626-world-cup-2026-ivory-coast-make-history-by-reaching-the-knockout-stage |title=World Cup 2026: Ivory Coast make history by reaching the knockout stage |publisher=France 24 |date=26 June 2026 |access-date=26 June 2026 |archive-date=30 June 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260630213843/https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/sports/20260626-world-cup-2026-ivory-coast-make-history-by-reaching-the-knockout-stage |url-status=live }}</ref>

==Style of play==
[[File:John Yeboah Yan Diomande Cote D'Ivoire v Ecuador 14 June 2026-178.jpg|thumb|Diomande (in orange) playing for [[Ivory Coast national football team|Ivory Coast]] in 2026]]
Diomande is an explosive and versatile [[Midfielder#winger|winger]] who is capable of operating on either flank. He often looks to receive the ball in wide areas before using his acceleration and strength to drive past defenders or carry the ball into the penalty area. Though primarily right-footed, Diomande is comfortable using both feet, allowing him to cut inside, deliver into the box or finish from different angles.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://breakingthelines.com/@btl/from-florida-high-school-to-bundesliga-wunderkid-the-tactical-profile-of-yan-diomande |title=From Florida High School to Bundesliga Wunderkid: The Tactical Profile of Yan Diomande |publisher=Breaking The Lines |date=29 June 2026 |access-date=8 August 2026 |archive-date=9 August 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260809040403/https://breakingthelines.com/@btl/from-florida-high-school-to-bundesliga-wunderkid-the-tactical-profile-of-yan-diomande |url-status=live }}</ref>

Diomande has been compared to [[Sadio Mané]] and [[Antonio Nusa]] for his direct style. He is dynamic and explosive on the ball, using his pace, strength and dribbling to beat defenders in 1v1 situations.<ref>{{cite web |last=Mawson |first=Daniel |url=https://www.givemesport.com/yan-diomande-scout-report/ |title=Yan Diomande Scout Report: Ivory Coast Star's Tactical Profile |publisher=GiveMeSport |date=17 June 2026 |access-date=8 August 2026 |archive-date=9 August 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260809070637/https://www.givemesport.com/yan-diomande-scout-report/ |url-status=live }}</ref> He is capable of turning quickly, changing pace and using his close control to evade opponents in tight spaces. He frequently uses a half-turn to shift the ball away from defenders before accelerating into the space behind them. His physicality and ability to carry the ball over long distances also make him particularly dangerous in transition.<ref>{{cite web |last=Benson |first=Ryan |url=https://theanalyst.com/articles/yan-diomande-real-madrid-transfer-journey-stats |title=The Meteoric Rise of Yan Diomande: From Nomadic Triallist to Bundesliga Superstar and a €140m Real Madrid Transfer |publisher=Opta Analyst |date=6 August 2026 |access-date=8 August 2026 |archive-date=8 August 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260808142601/https://theanalyst.com/articles/yan-diomande-real-madrid-transfer-journey-stats |url-status=live }}</ref>
